full_name: Katherine Ibbett | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2012–2013 Humanities Radcliffe Institute Fellow University College London (United Kingdom)
bio: Katherine Ibbett, a scholar of 17th-century French literature and culture, is a reader in French at University College London. Her research explores the relations between literary and political discourses in early modern Europe.
